request.initial_prompt: Now, Charmian! Show me, my women, like a queen. Go fetch My best attires. I am again for Cydnus To meet Mark Antony. Sirrah, Iras, go. Now, noble Charmian, we'll dispatch indeed, And when thou hast done this chare, I'll give thee leave To play till doomsday. Bring our crown and all.
